text_ja: 前項の規定にかかわらず、TLAC規制対象最終指定親会社については、第二条第三号の算式におけるTier2資本に係る調整項目の額は、前項各号に掲げる額の合計額に、次に掲げる額(前項各号に該当する額を除く。)の合計額を加えた額とする。一意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額二最終指定親会社等が保有し、かつ、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段で、最終指定親会社が第八条第七項の規定により少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額を算出するに当たり、その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額から控除するものとして指定しているもの(次号及び同項第一号において「マーケット・メイク目的保有TLAC」という。)のうち、保有中に次に掲げる要件のいずれかを欠くに至ったものの額イ当該最終指定親会社等のトレーディング商品(連結貸借対照表の科目のトレーディング商品をいう。第十一条の三及び第七章において同じ。)に含まれること。ロ保有期間が三十営業日以内であること。三マーケット・メイク目的保有TLACの額の合計額から、前号に掲げる額及び少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額(第八条第七項第一号に規定する少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額をいう。)の合計額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)
text_en: Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, with respect to TLAC-regulated Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by adding to the sum of the amounts set forth in each item of the preceding paragraph the sum of the following amounts (excluding amounts falling under each item of the preceding paragraph). (i) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally. (ii) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. and that are designated by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company as those to be deducted from the total amount of other external TLAC-related instruments in calculating the total amount of target capital instruments, etc. relating to minority investments pursuant to Article 8, paragraph (7), and that satisfy all of the following requirements (hereinafter referred to as "market-making TLAC" in the following item and item (i) of the same paragraph), where such instruments have ceased to satisfy either of the following requirements during the holding period. (a) That they are included in trading instruments (meaning trading instruments as an account item on the consolidated balance sheet; the same applies in Article 11-3 and Chapter VII) of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (b) That the holding period is within thirty business days. (iii) The amount obtained by deducting from the total amount of market-making TLAC the sum of the amount set forth in the preceding item and the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments (meaning the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments as provided in Article 8, paragraph (7), item (i)) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero).

一意図的に保有している他の金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額

二最終指定親会社等が保有し、かつ、次に掲げる要件の全てを満たす少数出資金融機関等のその他外部TLAC関連調達手段で、最終指定親会社が第八条第七項の規定により少数出資に係る対象資本等調達手段合計額を算出するに当たり、その他外部TLAC関連調達手段の額の合計額から控除するものとして指定しているもの(次号及び同項第一号において「マーケット・メイク目的保有TLAC」という。)のうち、保有中に次に掲げる要件のいずれかを欠くに至ったものの額イ当該最終指定親会社等のトレーディング商品(連結貸借対照表の科目のトレーディング商品をいう。第十一条の三及び第七章において同じ。)に含まれること。ロ保有期間が三十営業日以内であること。
三マーケット・メイク目的保有TLACの額の合計額から、前号に掲げる額及び少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額(第八条第七項第一号に規定する少数出資に係る五パーセント基準額をいう。)の合計額を控除した額(当該額が零を下回る場合にあっては、零とする。)

clauses_en.text: Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph, with respect to TLAC-regulated Ultimate Designated Parent Companies, the amount of adjustment items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by adding to the sum of the amounts set forth in each item of the preceding paragraph the sum of the following amounts
(excluding amounts falling under each item of the preceding paragraph)
(i) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally.

(ii) The amount of other external TLAC-related instruments of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. that are held by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. and that are designated by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company as those to be deducted from the total amount of other external TLAC-related instruments in calculating the total amount of target capital instruments, etc. relating to minority investments pursuant to Article 8, paragraph (7), and that satisfy all of the following requirements (hereinafter referred to as "market-making TLAC" in the following item and item (i) of the same paragraph), where such instruments have ceased to satisfy either of the following requirements during the holding period. (a) That they are included in trading instruments (meaning trading instruments as an account item on the consolidated balance sheet; the same applies in Article 11-3 and Chapter VII) of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. (b) That the holding period is within thirty business days.

(iii) The amount obtained by deducting from the total amount of market-making TLAC the sum of the amount set forth in the preceding item and the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments (meaning the 5% threshold amount relating to minority investments as provided in Article 8, paragraph (7), item (i)) (where such amount falls below zero, it shall be zero).
